description.zh:
管理动作名，取值：
1. open - 生效公钥，默认值
2. close - 失效公钥
description.en:
Name of the management action. Valid values:

1. open — Activate the public key. This is the default value.

2. close — Deactivate the public key.

description.zh: 公钥分组，如果KeyName不存在，则下发KeyGroup内所有的公钥
description.en: Name of the public key group. If you do not specify KeyName, all public keys in this group are applied.

description.zh: 公钥名称，与KeyGroup至少存在一个
description.en: Name of the public key. You must specify either KeyName or KeyGroup.
